name: Zaivern Code
description: A Rust-based AI cockpit that lets developers operate multiple AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) simultaneously from a unified interface. Features include broadcasting commands to all active agents, fleet monitoring with status tracking, one-click approval management, mobile remote control, and a built-in code editor. Supports 29 different AI coding tool presets with automatic startup configuration.
community_quotes: Rust cockpit for parallel AI coding agents
AI development cockpit for coordinating multiple AI agents
Broadcast same instruction to all active AI agents from one input field
エージェントは、もう十分に速い。次に速くなるのは、指揮するあなたです。

name: Wallfacer
description: A terminal session manager for Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Kiro CLI, and Codex that indexes all AI coding sessions across multiple agents. Provides unified search, organization (rename, tag, group into projects), resumption by ID prefix or title, and safe deletion with trash functionality. Offers both full-screen TUI and CLI interfaces with extensible adapter architecture for adding new agents.
community_quotes: A terminal session manager for Claude Code, and more
See every AI coding session you've ever started, then name, tag, group, search, resume, or delete them
One view of everything — every session, from every directory and every agent
After a few weeks you have dozens of transcripts, across four agents, that you can't tell apart and no way to find the one you need

name: Mirafold
description: A browser-based generative UI wrapper for terminal coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) that transforms dense terminal scrollback into clear, readable visual interfaces. Renders live cards, charts, and dashboards that can be pinned and monitored in real-time. Features multi-session management with centralized mission control grid view, mobile access support, and sandboxed iframes with restricted CSP for secure arbitrary UI generation.
community_quotes: Your Agent with Generative UI (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini)
Transforms dense scrollback into a clear, readable interface
Renders live cards, charts, and dashboards you can pin and watch update
